cwe_descriptions: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') — The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory.
CWE-177: Improper Handling of URL Encoding (Hex Encoding) — The product does not properly handle when all or part of an input has been URL encoded.
